metadata.short_desc: Garmin training and health data via the official Personal API, with daily push and weekly report
metadata.desc: Read-only access to Garmin Connect (official Personal API, China and International): activities, pace and heart-rate zones, body composition, sleep, heart rate and HRV, plus optional daily training/recovery push and weekly training report.

api_key.hint: Create it at connect.garmin.cn (or connect.garmin.com) → Settings → Personal API Key. It is shown only once and expires after 30/90/180 days or 1 year.

push_enabled.description: Enable daily training and recovery push
push_enabled.hint: Sends yesterday's training plus this morning's sleep, HRV and resting heart rate, with a training suggestion.

push_time.hint: 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 08:00, in the AstrBot host's local time.

weekly_enabled.hint: Pushes weekly volume, pace, heart-rate zone structure, sleep and HRV summary.
